dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: #Oh ho? Dear {NICKNAME} and Paimon, is that you I spy? Bit of a remote locale for an encounter, I must say.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Hot on the trail of some lead, perhaps? Or might you happen to be lost?

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: Ah, I see. Indeed, the massive silhouette of the Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau has a... peculiar grandeur when viewed from the deck of this wrecked ship — like some slumbering colossus.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah. It's super intimidating, even from way over here. Who knows how many secrets they've squirreled away in there...

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: I imagine it could be a fine source of inspiration for you, considering your pursuit of unique material in that regard.

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: After all, the most fascinating tales are often born from the interstice between light and darkness.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehehe, with you standing here holding your trusty blue lantern, this place looks like a scene right out of a story already!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Speaking of that, don't you have to man your post at... uh... that place? Are you on leave, or on patrol and stuff?

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: Both, you could say. We Ratniki keep eternal watch for any calamity that might emerge from the shadows. As such, we must remain vigilant no matter where we are.

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: That said, things do appear stable around here, so no need to fret over-much. Go about your creative endeavor in peace.

choices.text: Well, since the opportunity's presenting itself...

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: Of me? An unexpected request, if I may say so. I must confess that I am unused to standing in front of a Kamera — to being the watched rather than the watcher.

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: I suppose it comes of having silent graves and the whispers of the dead as common company. I'm sure you get where I'm coming from.

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: Still, t'would be uncouth to reject a friend's earnest entreaty. A travesty against the spirit of hospitality.

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: So, feel free to record that which you find most worthy of remembrance. It would be an honor and a pleasure to aid in inspiring you, if only a little.

choices.text: Could we take a picture of you?
And looking for some photo-op material while we're at it.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Have you found clarity on how to capture this moment?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We're good. Let the photo-op begin!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: One moment. The inspiration's not quite coming yet...

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: #Why, if it isn't {NICKNAME} and Paimon? Hot on the trail of some lead, perhaps? Or might you happen to be lost?

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: I see. May this silent colossus provide you with the inspiration you seek, then.

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: That said, I do not see your Kamera on you. Might you have misplaced it somewhere?

choices.text: And looking for some photo-op material while we're at it.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Judging from your expressions, you're still looking for suitable material for your photo-op, yes? Don't worry, you have time aplenty — and many are the true masterworks that found their initial spark from unexpected corners.

choices.text: We're good. Let the photo-op begin!

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: It seems you've figured something out. That said, I do not see your Kamera on you. Might you have misplaced it somewhere?

choices.text: One moment. The inspiration's not quite coming yet...
